title: How Far Does the Rolling Corner Travel? | AMC 10-Style Level 4
description:
A little square tumbles all the way around a bigger square. How far does one of its corners travel? Vantee follows the roll one move at a time, spots the sneaky half turn at each corner (and the moves where the corner doesn't budge), then glues the arcs into whole circles for a quick check. Then you track the center of the square yourself.
